resume: Chord groovebox modeled on the Roland J-6: 100 chord sets, 9 phrase styles in 12 variations, a 64-pattern sequencer and a 4-voice Juno-style synth with delay and reverb.

commandes.role: Octave down. With GLO, transpose. On the sequencer, previous step page.
Octave up. With GLO, transpose. On the sequencer, next step page.
One press: chord mode. Held (or with GLO): chord map.
HOLD. In step editing, ties the step to the next.
Page of the 64 sounds, in 8 banks.
Shift key: held, gives the second function of the buttons and knobs. Held with PRESETS, jumps a bank.
Saves the pattern. With GLO, saves all patterns.
One press: phrase on or off. Held: phrase page.
Sequencer page. A second time, grid of the 64 patterns.
One press: play or stop. Held: full stop, all sound cut.
Real-time recording: REC, then PLAY, then play.
Tempo, or whatever the page steps through (chord sets, sounds, patterns, settings, steps).
Notes, or chords in chord mode. On the sequencer, they enter the step's notes.

gestes: GLO + PLAY: play from the chosen step.

modes.texte: 64 steps in 4 pages of 16. PRESETS chooses the step, the keys enter notes or chords, SEQ finishes. GLO held and a white key give the step tools.

a_savoir: HERA keeps its 64 patterns in its own area of the flash. Installing another firmware may overwrite them, and they cannot yet be copied out of the FM-1.
